metadata.question: Was surface water extent higher on February 25, 2019 as compared to February 27, 2014 in the Mississippi River near the Memphis, Tennesse?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Mississippi River near Memphis, Tennessee (~35.15°N, -90.05°W) - Dates: February 25, 2019 vs February 27, 2014 - Collection: JRC Global Surface Water or Sentinel-1 SAR for water detection - For 2014: Landsat 8 is available (launched Feb 2013) - For 2019: Sentinel-2 or Landsat 8 available - Best approach: Use JRC Monthly Water History or calculate water extent from optical/SAR data 2. Masking strategy: - Need to identify water pixels, not mask them - Use water indices (NDWI, MNDWI) or JRC water occurrence - For Landsat: MNDWI = (Green - SWIR1) / (Green + SWIR1), threshold > 0 for water - Cloud masking is important for optical data 3. Logic: - Calculate total water pixel count for each date - Compare: 2019_water_count > 2014_water_count → A (Yes), else → B (No) - Watch for C1 (no images), C2 (no valid pixels after masking), C3 (calculation failure) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define location - Mississippi River near Memphis, TN const memphis = ee.Geometry.Point([-90.05, 35.15]); const roi = memphis.buffer(10000); // 10km buffer around Memphis // 2. Date ranges const date2014_start = '2014-02-20'; const date2014_end = '2014-03-05'; const date2019_start = '2019-02-18'; const date2019_end = '2019-03-05'; // 3. Function to calculate water extent using Landsat 8 function calculateWaterExtent(startDate, endDate, year) { let collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const size = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`${year} Images found: ${size}`); if (size === 0) { return null; } // Cloud masking function for Landsat 8 Collection 2 function maskClouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(cloudMask); } // Calculate MNDWI for water detection function addWaterIndex(image) { const mndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3', 'SR_B6']).rename('MNDWI'); return image.addBands(mndwi); } const processed = collection .map(maskClouds) .map(addWaterIndex) .median(); // Threshold MNDWI > 0 for water const water = processed.select('MNDWI').gt(0); // Count water pixels const stats = water.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: roi, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const waterCount = stats.get('MNDWI_sum').getInfo(); const totalCount = stats.get('MNDWI_count').getInfo(); console.log(`${year} - Water pixels: ${waterCount}, Valid pixels: ${totalCount}`); return { waterCount: waterCount, validCount: totalCount }; } // 4. Calculate for both dates const result2014 = calculateWaterExtent(date2014_start, date2014_end, '2014'); if (result2014 === null) { console.log("No images found for 2014"); console.log("C1"); return; } if (result2014.validCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels for 2014 after masking"); console.log("C2"); return; } const result2019 = calculateWaterExtent(date2019_start, date2019_end, '2019'); if (result2019 === null) { console.log("No images found for 2019"); console.log("C1"); return; } if (result2019.validCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels for 2019 after masking"); console.log("C2"); return; } // 5. Validation and comparison if (result2014.waterCount === null || result2019.waterCount === null || isNaN(result2014.waterCount) || isNaN(result2019.waterCount)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid results"); console.log("C3"); return; } console.log(`\nComparison: 2019 water extent (${result2019.waterCount}) vs 2014 (${result2014.waterCount})`); if (result2019.waterCount > result2014.waterCount) { console.log("Surface water extent was HIGHER in 2019"); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("Surface water extent was NOT higher in 2019"); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
